headline: US Thanksgiving Dinner Costs Increase 6% to $58.63 on High Turkey Prices
summary: An American Farm Bureau Federation survey found the average cost of a Thanksgiving dinner for 10 people rose 6% from last year to $58.63, driven by record high turkey prices and elevated fuel costs.
why: The American Farm Bureau Federation's annual Thanksgiving survey is a widely watched retail price gauge for US food consumer inflation.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Higher grocery retail prices signal persistent food price pressure for consumers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
